series.title: Sorry, Tomorrow
series.description: Sorry, Tomorrow is a colorful workplace satire about Ahead AI—an agency that scales first and locates the intelligence later.
series.disclosure: AI-assisted; human-written, directed, edited, and approved.

episodes.title: Chief Image Officer
episodes.label: Comic 022 · Ahead AI
episodes.caption: Dex discovers an image generator. Leadership gets a makeover.

ogImage.alt: Chief Image Officer title beside Dex presenting his image generator to the team.

art.alt: Dex excitedly presents his laptop to Clara, Mina and Wes in a sunlit office. Clara folds her arms, Mina leans in and Wes sips coffee.
Dex hunches over the laptop with his tongue poking out as he types one key. In a diagonal reaction panel, Wes holds an empty mug while Mina waits with her chin in her hand.
In a cinematic three-dimensional transformation, Dex stands heroically beneath blue lightning hitting his raised clicker. A jagged frame separates ordinary comic-style Wes holding an unplugged cord.
A green voxel-built Dex tips a square mug and spills a stream of cubic coffee down his suit. Across a stepped frame, Clara offers a napkin with an unimpressed look.
Black-and-white rubber-hose Dex bounces across the scene and stretches one long arm across a curved frame to clasp Wes’s hand while Wes types with his other hand.
Dex and his navy suit melt like a soft oil painting over his chair into a swirling puddle. Clara lifts both feet onto her own chair to escape the spreading paint.
Mina beams with pink heart-shaped pupils while holding an adorable tiny knitted Dex in her cupped hands. A braided yarn curve frames the chibi executive.
Dex is a huge fierce demon with hooves, wings, glowing eyes, ember armor and branching horns. Unimpressed Mina hangs his suit jacket directly on one of the horns.
Back in ordinary office form, Clara asks about an effective CEO while Mina and Wes laugh. Dex misses the joke and eagerly turns back to the laptop.

episodes.title: Funnel or Flush?
episodes.label: Comic 021 · Ahead AI
episodes.caption: You’re just one more step away from one more step.

ogImage.alt: Funnel or Flush? title beside the opening scene: Wes asks for a stapler; Dex withholds it and demands a STAPLER comment to send his workflow.

art.alt: Wes reaches for a stapler across Dex’s desk: ‘Pass the stapler?’ Dex pulls it back with a smug smile: ‘Comment ‘STAPLER’ and I’ll send you my workflow.’

Inside a toilet stall, Dex sits facing away, phone in his left hand on the left, right hand on his right knee. A gold-framed dispenser holds a full roll behind a clear locked cover. Its ad reads UPGRADE YOUR STALL, $9.99/month. Toilet paper is a Premium Feature.
Dex taps SUBSCRIBE on the dispenser with his right index finger while holding his phone in his left hand. The display says WELCOME TO PREMIUM! His expression brightens.
Dex stares in disbelief at one tiny square of toilet paper pinched in his right hand. The full roll remains behind the cover. The display says YOU’VE REACHED YOUR MONTHLY LIMIT.
Defeated, Dex turns left toward his phone. The tiny scrap sits on the toilet cistern. The display says INVITE 3 FRIENDS TO UNLOCK ANOTHER SQUARE.

Back in the office, a blue notification explicitly connected to a phone reads DEX: ‘I don’t normally share products, but this one has genuinely changed my life.’ ‘Use my code: DEX10.’ The code is highlighted yellow. Clara laughs behind her hand: ‘Isn’t he still in the bathroom?’ Wes smugly sips coffee: ‘Yeah. He needs three followers to finish.’

episodes.title: Chief Expendable Officer
episodes.label: Comic 020 · Ahead AI
episodes.caption: Dex gives his new agentic workforce a mandate to eliminate redundant work.

ogImage.alt: Chief Expendable Officer title beside the opening scene: Dex proudly tells three robot agents to find every redundant role and be ruthless.

art.alt: Dex confidently addresses three small robot agents in a sunny office. A display reads AGENTIC WORKFORCE. Dex says, ‘Find every redundant role. Be ruthless.’
Dex gives a proud thumbs-up beside a screen headed OWNER: DEX VANE. It lists 12 MEETINGS — CANCELED; 6 DAILY STATUS REPORTS — STOPPED; OUR STRATEGY FOR DEVELOPING A STRATEGY — DELETED.

Two small robot guards escort a startled Dex through the office. He carries a cardboard box holding his mug and plant. A third robot on a stepladder removes the DEX VANE nameplate from his office door. Silent panel.

Dex is folded inside a red glass-front emergency cabinet labeled HUMAN ACCOUNTABILITY. Beside an external hammer, a sign reads BREAK GLASS IN CASE OF LAWSUIT. Wes walks past with coffee and a smirk: ‘Good news. They found something they can’t automate.’

episodes.title: Dyson "Sphere Pressure"
episodes.label: Comic 019 · Ahead AI
episodes.caption: When the data-center plan gets a no, executive brainstorming gets creative.

ogImage.alt: Dyson "Sphere Pressure" title beside the opening office scene: Dex considers Token with a scheming smile, Clara rolls her eyes and Wes smirks.

art.alt: In the bright Ahead AI office, Dex leans toward Token on the desk, thumb on chin and a scheming smile. Clara rolls her eyes; Wes smirks behind them. Dex says, "The Board says the government won’t approve our new data center." Clara says, "Maybe we should just build a Dyson sphere around Token." Token raises his hands and says, "Wait, what?"

Tiny Token runs anxiously inside a monumental glowing spherical framework built around a hamster wheel. One boot meets the inner tread while his other leg lifts and his arms pump. The wheel axle enters a generator, and a huge ribbed power cable exits its output terminal across the office floor. No dialogue.

Dex and Mina lounge in adjacent beach chairs in swimsuits and tanning goggles, smiling despite visibly sunburnt cheeks, shoulders and knees. The ribbed cable plugs into the base of twin tanning lamps shining onto both chairs. Token keeps running in the background wheel; ordinary sunshine is visible through the office windows. Dex says, "The power of the sun, right in our office." Behind them Clara folds her arms, rolls her eyes and says, "You could just go outside, you know." Wes smirks beside her.

episodes.title: The Reset King
episodes.label: Comic 018 · Ahead AI
episodes.caption: A little free reset goes a long way.

ogImage.alt: The Reset King title beside Token on a golden throne, pouring coins onto Clara’s umbrella.

art.alt: Tiny Token lounges on an enormous gold throne in a jeweled crown, heavy chains and a fur-trimmed red cape, above gold bars stamped FREE RESETS. He pours one stream of gold reset coins from a chalice onto Clara’s navy umbrella. Clara rolls her eyes and holds her coffee. Coins slide off the right edge into Wes’s outstretched mug and off the left edge into Mina’s gathered shirt and Dex’s open briefcase. Mina and Dex look delighted; Wes feigns indifference. No dialogue.

episodes.title: Bot-tourage
episodes.label: Comic 017 · Ahead AI
episodes.caption: Dex asks his new helpers to keep him updated. Every step.

ogImage.alt: Bot-tourage title beside the complete opening panel: Dex asks Bot and Dot to keep him updated in the Ahead AI office.

art.alt: In the sunlit Ahead AI office, Dex smiles and gestures to two small robots on his desk. Bot wears a tuxedo and top hat; Dot wears a lavender dress with cream polka dots and a gold neck bow. Both salute. Dex says, “Keep me updated. Every step. Don't let me miss a thing.”

Bot announces, “Your fluffy cat slippers have arrived!” Dot adds, “ooo extra fluffy!” Dex blushes and touches the back of his head. Clara laughs sheepishly behind her hand, while Wes smiles nearby. The slippers are not shown.

Dex and his wife sit at the same candlelit restaurant table beneath a chandelier. The waiter asks, “And for you, sir?” Bot, on a spare chair with Dot, interrupts: “Reminder: ask your wife about her day.” Dot adds, “Before you talk about work.” Dex freezes over his menu; his wife raises an angry, suspicious eyebrow.

Beside an opaque coral shower curtain, Bot and Dot sit together on a closed toilet lid. Dot has a lavender shower cap. Dex is entirely hidden except for a hand gripping the curtain. Bot says, “Reminder: take some time for yourself!”
At night, a wide-eyed Dex lies awake in striped pajamas. One cat paws his head while another kneads his chest. On the nightstand, Bot says, “Reminder: feed the cats.” Dot adds, “They seem hungry.”

Back in the office, an exhausted Dex wears a suit jacket and tie over striped pajama pants and fluffy cat slippers. Wes hands him coffee and says, “Guess what—I got you another bot!” A third cheerful robot in a sage vest and coral head bow steps forward. Bot and Dot turn toward it, throw their arms up, and cheer silently.
In an extreme close-up, Dex's eyes bulge and his teeth clench. A coffee cup trembles in his left hand. He says, “Ohh no.”

episodes.title: Up, Up, and Out of Tokens
episodes.label: Comic 016 · Ahead AI
episodes.caption: Up, Up, and Out of Tokens

ogImage.alt: Up, Up, and Out of Tokens: Mina activates Ultrafast while small Token celebrates and Dex and Wes watch.

art.alt: In the sunlit Ahead AI office, Mina presses a console and says “Ultrafast is live.” Small Token celebrates with three glowing quota lights and a glowing T. Dex and Wes watch. A display reads “QUOTA — 100%”.

Token tap-dances on a keyboard to answer emails, finishes a checked six-slide pitch deck with his trailing hand, and delivers a neat stack of clipped client packets. Three task labels name the completed work. Quota displays decline from three lit segments to one while Mina, Dex and Wes watch.

Token’s head and hands droop and his knees buckle. His eyes, T and three quota windows are black. A large alarm reads “0 TOKENS”. His bright speed trail has broken off behind him; an intact printer lies ahead.

“KRRRAAASH!” Token’s momentum bursts through a printer and a wooden desk brace, collapsing two desks and scattering chairs, paper and equipment. Mina, Dex and Wes react safely behind their workstation. The small robot remains intact and unpowered.

Amid extensive wrecked desks, printer pieces, toppled chairs and paper drifts, Mina kneels beside small unpowered Token and steadies his head. Dex celebrates: “Boom! A thousand percent efficiency—in half the time!” Wes looks skeptical. Token’s UI reads “QUOTA EXHAUSTED — RESETS IN 7 DAYS”. Boomer adds “4. BUY A NEW PRINTER” after three existing project tasks on the whiteboard.

episodes.label: Comic 015 · Ahead AI
episodes.caption: Chief Babysitting Engineer

ogImage.alt: Link preview for Chief Babysitting Engineer: the complete opening panel shows Dex announcing the board’s efficiency target while Mina listens.

art.alt: Dex presents the board’s demand for 10,000% more efficiency while Mina listens at her laptop.
Dex enthusiastically pitches adding agents to manage agents while Mina leans toward her laptop, excited.

Mina, exhausted with a towel over her shoulder and bottle in hand, is surrounded by three baby robots asking for tokens, approval and permission to eat. Wes laughs beside Clara’s silent, gritted-teeth reaction.

lines.speaker: Dex
lines.text: The board wants us to be 10,000% more efficient with AI.

panels.description: Mina listens with a curious spark beside her laptop.

lines.speaker: Dex
lines.text: We’ll add more agents! Then agents can manage more agents!

panels.description: Mina eagerly leans closer to her laptop, excited by Dex’s plan.

lines.speaker: Angry robot
lines.text: I can’t proceed without your approval!

lines.speaker: Hungry robot
lines.text: I need your permission to eat!

lines.speaker: Wes
lines.text: Congratulations, Mina. You’ve been promoted to Chief Babysitting Engineer.

panels.description: Mina tends the three needy baby robots in the office. Clara watches silently with a strained expression.

episodes.title: The Assistant’s Assistant
episodes.label: Comic 012 · Ahead AI
episodes.caption: Finally, someone to take work off your plate.

art.alt: In a sunlit office, Boomer sits at a spacious wooden desk and gestures happily toward a smiling AI face on his monitor. A narrow wheeled telephone desk waits nearby. He says, “Finally! An AI assistant to handle all my day-to-day work”
A closer view shows Boomer listening with a finger to his headset. The AI smiles from his monitor and says, “Could you handle the calls? I need somewhere quiet to work.”

Cheerfully pushing the narrow desk, its full-size telephone and appointment pad through his office doorway, Boomer says, “Of course. I’ll work out here.” The AI remains at the spacious workstation inside.

Clara approaches Boomer, who is now seated at the tiny telephone desk in the hallway, his knees crowded around its supports. His former workstation and the AI remain inside the glass office. Clara asks, “Can I talk to your AI assistant?” Boomer raises a helpful finger and replies, “Do you have an appointment?”

episodes.title: Incognito Mode
episodes.label: Comic 011 · Ahead AI
episodes.caption: A four-panel Sorry, Tomorrow comic.

art.alt: In a sunny office, Mina sits at a desk facing a smiling cyan AI face projected above the monitor labeled AI 1. Original AI: “I've checked your code. Everything is correct.” Mina: “Perfect. I trust you.”

Hidden behind a large plant, Mina wears sunglasses and a fake mustache, cupping her hand beside her mouth toward a laptop labeled AI 2 resting on her lap. Token watches an approaching Wes through binoculars. Mina: “Check this code. I don't believe a word it said.”
Wes parts the plant's leaves and bends toward Mina. Startled, she grasps his collar; the AI 2 laptop remains on her lap. Wes: “Why are you wearing a disguise?”

Mina whispers to Wes beside the plant: “My other AI thinks we’re exclusive.” Across the office, AI 1's face now glows red with an angry frown. Token holds his lowered binoculars and says, “You know it can hear you, right?”

episodes.title: Work Life Balance
episodes.label: Comic 010 · Ahead AI
episodes.caption: Mina finds a very comfortable use for the time her new AI saves.

art.alt: In a warm office, Mina sits in a normal black office chair with one hand on the mouse. She turns toward standing Wes with an exaggerated proud grin. Her monitor offers to make a presentation from a client brief.
A closer two-shot holds their eye contact. Wes smiles and opens one hand as he asks his question. Mina looks up at him while reaching down beside her chair, out of view.

The office is subtly dimmed, but the monitor remains bright. Mina is now cocooned in a huge teal recliner and a coral-and-cream blanket, surrounded by a giant popcorn bucket, a large soda, and an excessive candy stash. She looks toward Wes and presses a finger to her lips, treating the presentation's 99% progress as a movie climax. Wes looks mildly taken aback.

lines.speaker: Mina
lines.text: This new AI makes the whole client presentation for me. Two hours of work—one click.

The Agent reports that the lease payment is 38 days late and that a customer has been waiting on Line 2 for 36 hours. The room maintains its polite presentation composure.
